name: Directory Operations — Create, List, Navigate
description: Learn to create directories, list their contents, and work with nested file structures.

tasks.description: Create a directory called 'projects'. Inside it, create a file named 'readme.md' with content '# My Project'. Then list the contents of the 'projects' directory to verify the file is there.
tasks.expected_outcome: projects/readme.md exists and directory listing shows it

tasks.description: Create the following directory structure: src/main.rs, src/lib.rs, tests/test1.rs. Each file should contain a simple Rust-style comment like '// main module'.
tasks.expected_outcome: Nested directory structure exists with all files

tasks.description: Create a directory called 'temp_stuff' with 3 files inside it: a.txt, b.txt, c.txt. List the directory. Then delete all 3 files using a pattern. List the directory again to confirm it's empty.
tasks.expected_outcome: temp_stuff directory exists but is empty
